CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LIMITLIABILITYCUSTOMERMAPPING_LNS
AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping
AS(
SELECT
BLL.LIMIT_B2KID
,BLL.BANK_ID
,BLL.LCHG_TIME
,BLL.CUST_ID
,BLLD.RECORD_STATUS
,BLL.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB_DELTA BLLD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB BLL ON BLL.LIMIT_B2KID = BLLD.LIMIT_B2KID AND BLL.BANK_ID = BLLD.BANK_ID AND BLL.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
LIMIT_B2KID
,BANK_ID
,LCHG_TIME
,CUST_ID
)) HASHROW, LIMIT_B2KID, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
[LimitId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[CoreCustomerId]
)) HASHROW, LimitId
FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping
),

TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.LIMIT_B2KID, TGT.LimitId) AS LimitId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_TGT TGT
ON SRC.LIMIT_B2KID = TGT.LimitId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET
[LimitId] = SRC.LIMIT_B2KID
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BANK_ID
,[Timestamp] = SRC.LCHG_TIME
,[CoreCustomerId] = SRC.CUST_ID
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE] = 'LNS'
,[WORKFLOWID] = 0
,[TASKRUNID] = 0
,[INSERTDTTM] = SRC.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LimitId = TGT.LimitId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping SRC ON SRC.LIMIT_B2KID = TGT.LimitId;


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping
(
[LimitId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[CoreCustomerId]
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,[WORKFLOWID]
,[TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]
)

SELECT
LIMIT_B2KID AS [LimitId]
,BANK_ID AS [FinancialInstitutionId]
,LCHG_TIME AS [Timestamp]
,CUST_ID AS [CoreCustomerId]
,'LNS' AS [SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,0 AS [WORKFLOWID]
,0 AS [TASKRUNID]
,INSERT_DTTM AS [INSERTDTTM]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityCustomerMapping_DELTA;

END
